bindings.title: Rebuild the Google Sheets node "Record Rejected Input"
bindings.detail: This node is typed as Google Sheets but carries "base", "table", which are not parameters that node has - they belong to a different n8n node. behaviour.title: Replace the Twilio sender number
behaviour.detail: The from number is +15550100000, which is in the reserved fictional 555-01xx range and is not a number anyone can send from. Twilio rejects it. Put a number on your own account here, or a Messaging Service SID.

behaviour.title: Set a real fallback for the placeholder expressions
behaviour.detail: "ONCALL_NUMBER" appears as the fallback branch of an expression. When the upstream field is missing the expression does not fail - it resolves to that literal string and the call is made with it, which reads downstream as a malformed value rather than as missing data.

bindings.title: Import "lib: Research Specialist" and select it on Research Specialist (Sub-workflow)
bindings.detail: This template calls a separate workflow named lib: Research Specialist, and it is included in your download as lib/lib-research-specialist.json. Import that file into n8n first (Workflows -> Import from File), then open Research Specialist (Sub-workflow) and pick it in the workflowId selector. The selector is empty until you do: a workflow id only exists inside your own instance, so it cannot be set for you.
